title: Transcribe a call in the background
summary: Start or stop background transcription on a live call through REST and receive available transcript text at your status webhook.
scenario: You want each support call's text filed against its ticket

evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json calling.transcribe variant: control_id required, status_url; calling.transcribe.stop: control_id
tools/openapi/rest.json webhooks transcribe_status_callback: event_type completed|failed, params.text omitted when none
SWML transcribe verb is absent from the 3.0.1 bundled schema, so the recipe uses REST
